drhp.expansion: The Company is expanding its residential development pipeline in the Panvel and Pune micro-markets. Its ongoing Panvel project, Belmac Infinity, received regulatory approval during the year for three additional floors, enhancing its development potential. A further residential development at Koproli, Panvel is under planning and pre-development activity, expected to benefit from the region's infrastructure growth. Two earlier township projects, Belmac Residences (Pune) and Belmac Riverside (Panvel), have been completed and handed over.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's resilient economic fundamentals and sustained policy support expected to provide a favorable environment for investment, infrastructure development, and long-term growth across the real estate sector.
- The Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) is undergoing major infrastructure transformation (new international airport, upgraded road network including the coastal road, expanding metro connectivity), expected to reinforce MMR's status as a key economic hub and drive substantial growth in the housing market.
- Demand for homes has significantly increased due to economic growth, rising income levels, and stabilizing housing prices, with first-time and experienced homeowners seeking larger areas; remote/hybrid work trends are increasing desire for larger living spaces.
- India's real estate sector demand remained healthy in well-connected micro-markets supported by expanding transport infrastructure and employment hubs, with steady demand in mid-income segments driven by lifestyle aspirations, demographics, and preference for larger, amenity-rich homes.
- Panvel is emerging as one of the most promising real estate destinations in MMR owing to transformational infrastructure including the Navi Mumbai International Airport, Atal Setu, Mumbai Trans Harbour Link, upcoming metro connectivity, and planned NAINA development.
- Fluctuations in construction material prices, financing costs, and global economic uncertainties remain headwinds, though the long-term outlook remains positive on favourable demographics, urbanisation, government policy reforms, and infrastructure-led growth.
- The decline in revenue and profitability during the year reflects a natural transition-phase timing difference between completed projects and the commencement of revenue recognition from the next phase of developments (Belmac Infinity progressing, Koproli Panvel under planning), rather than a reflection of underlying operational strength.
- Ongoing project Belmac Infinity (Panvel) witnessed a substantial improvement in sales during the financial year, reflecting growing market confidence in the Belmac brand.
- Upcoming residential development at Koproli, Panvel is under planning and pre-development activities, forming part of the Company's long-term growth strategy.
- Company's underlying project pipeline and long-term growth prospects described as remaining strong despite the year's lower revenue/profit recognition.

capex_expansion.body: The Company is expanding its residential development pipeline in the Panvel and Pune micro-markets. Its ongoing Panvel project, Belmac Infinity, received regulatory approval during the year for three additional floors, enhancing its development potential. A further residential development at Koproli, Panvel is under planning and pre-development activity, expected to benefit from the region's infrastructure growth. Two earlier township projects, Belmac Residences (Pune) and Belmac Riverside (Panvel), have been completed and handed over.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Unforeseen global economic uncertainties, including geopolitical tensions and supply chain disruptions, can impact real estate markets; economic slowdowns or recessions can lead to decreased demand and lower property values.
- Real estate contracts frequently include contingencies (deliverables, inspection etc.) that can entitle contractors to time extensions; inadequate contractual provisions could lead to business losses from unforeseeable events.
- It is critical to recruit and retain qualified workers amid growing competition; experienced employees may be poached as new competitors take an aggressive stance in the industry.
- Revenue and profit recognition are closely linked to project execution milestones and handovers, causing natural timing swings between years — the prior year's revenue reflected completion/handover of major projects while the year under review was a transition phase with fewer projects reaching revenue recognition.
- Fluctuations in construction material prices, financing costs, and global economic uncertainties continue to pose challenges to the real estate sector the Company operates in.
- The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act (RERA) requires the Company to promptly handle and resolve customer complaints, fostering an open and accountable climate for homebuyers.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Actively seeking opportunities in the Panvel region with the goal of developing large-scale townships.
- Exploring strategic joint ventures in the Pune market to support growth trajectory.
- Exploring options that promote sustainable growth, focusing on long-term value creation and resilience to maintain stability in the real estate market.
- Continuing to strengthen the development pipeline with strategically located projects, further expanding footprint in the Panvel region.
- Focus on execution excellence and prudent financial management across the project pipeline.
